purpose: descriptive full panel; no confirmatory inference
domain: each exact C1 nominal radius, no extension or shrinking of C1
nominal: reuse independently hashed C1 calibration; A2 for two failed C1 domains
geometry: unchanged A2 geometry.py and exact saved M/f; verify reconstruction from each checkpoint

level3.trigger: inconsistent event presence across level2 phases/resolutions or first onset spread >1e-4 R, or no stable Jacobi evidence despite persistent boundary crossing

area.rule: degree5 Dunavant 32 and 64 rings, 8192 rays for positives; use min first conjugate / first crossing; censored at nominal for no events

classification.positive: stable boundary event and/or stable conjugate zero with sign change before R under refinement; SPD valid; contradictory evidence INCONCLUSIVE
classification.injective: no sampled loss and stable screening; observational only
classification.numerical_failure: coarse anomaly disappears consistently under refinement attributable to discretization

reuse: 10 A2 states reuse complete verified stronger resolution phase and RK4 evidence; no rerun required
rinj: only numerical upper bound from positive events; no certified lower bound fabricated
cut_locus: persistent collisions without detected conjugate => probable only; independent distance minimization deferred T1-B
budget: finite predefined matrix, no replacements; exceptions documented; cap at level3; nominal radius only
persistence: atomic state result; immutable per-state diagnostic ZIP before progress commit; small batches at most 4; stop on upload failure
analysis: regime x split descriptive counts; initialization counts; censored area separate; Spearman and Pearson with available C1 metrics, no imputation; no p values
continuation: more than known 2 positive states => open T1-B; only known2 => specific case series, not population T1-B
